mapper.select: /* SQL ID : LogUserActvDAO.userCntnCntByOrgId 설 명 : 기관별 사용자 접속 인원수 */ WITH CNTN_LIST AS ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY LOG.SBJCT_ID, LOG.USER_ID, LOG.USER_TYCD ORDER BY LOG.ACTV_DTTM DESC) AS RN , SMSTR.ORG_ID , LOG.SBJCT_ID , LOG.USER_ID , LOG.USER_TYCD , LOG.USER_REQ_URL , LOG.ACTV_DTTM , LOG.ACTV_DATETIME FROM TB_LMS_LOG_USER_ACTV LOG JOIN TB_LMS_USER USR ON LOG.USER_ID = USR.USER_ID JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJ ON LOG.SBJCT_ID = SBJ.SBJCT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SMSTR ON SBJ.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = SMSTR.SMSTR_CHRT_ID WHERE 1=1 AND LOG.USER_TYCD = #{userTycd} AND LOG.SBJCT_ID IS NOT NULL AND LOG.ACTV_DATETIME >= (SYSDATE - NUMTODSINTERVAL(120, 'MINUTE')) ), FILTERED_CNTN_LIST AS ( SELECT ORG_ID, SBJCT_ID, USER_ID FROM CNTN_LIST WHERE RN = 1 ), STD_CNT_INFO AS ( SELECT ORG.ORG_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT STD.USER_ID ) AS STD_CNT FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJ JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SMSTR ON SMSTR.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = SBJ.SMSTR_CHRT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_ORG ORG ON SMSTR.ORG_ID = ORG.ORG_ID JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC STD ON SBJ.SBJCT_ID = STD.SBJCT_ID GROUP BY ORG.ORG_ID ) SELECT ORG.ORG_ID , ORG.ORG_SHRTNM , COUNT(CNTN.USER_ID) AS CNTN_CNT , NVL(STD.STD_CNT, 0) AS TOT_CNT FROM TB_LMS_ORG ORG LEFT JOIN FILTERED_CNTN_LIST CNTN ON ORG.ORG_ID = CNTN.ORG_ID LEFT JOIN STD_CNT_INFO STD ON ORG.ORG_ID = STD.ORG_ID WHERE 1=1 AND ORG.USEYN = 'Y' GROUP BY ORG.ORG_ID, ORG.ORG_SHRTNM, STD.STD_CNT ORDER BY ORG.ORG_ID

/* 설명 : 사용자과목접속목록조회 - 현재시간보다 120분이전 접속기록조회*/ SELECT * FROM ( SELECT S.SBJCT_ID, LUA.USER_ID, S.SBJCTNM, USR.USERNM, O.ORGNM, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY LUA.USER_ID ORDER BY LUA.ACTV_DATETIME DESC ) AS RN, NVL(USR.PHOTO_FILE_ID, 'user_img') AS USER_THUMBNAIL FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT_ADM ADM JOIN TB_LMS_LOG_USER_ACTV LUA ON LUA.SBJCT_ID = ADM.SBJCT_ID AND LUA.ACTV_DATETIME >= (SYSDATE - NUMTODSINTERVAL(120, 'MINUTE')) JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT S ON S.SBJCT_ID = ADM.SBJCT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_USER USR ON USR.USER_ID = LUA.USER_ID JOIN TB_LMS_ORG O ON O.ORG_ID = USR.ORG_ID WHERE ADM.USER_ID = #{userId} ) WHERE RN = 1 ORDER BY USERNM
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_LMS_LOG_USER_ACTV ( USER_ACTV_ID, USER_ID, SBJCT_ID, REQ_TYCD, SMSTR_CHRT_ID, ORG_ID, DEPT_ID, USER_RPRS_ID, USER_REQ_URL, USER_TYCD, NAVI_POSNM, CNTN_IP, CNTN_DVC_TYCD, CNTN_BRWSR, ACTV_DTTM, SESS_ID, SESS_SDTTM, RGTR_ID, REG_DTTM, ACTV_DATETIME, DAYOFWEEK, HOUROFDAY, TRACE_ID ) VALUES ( #{userActvId}, #{userId}, #{sbjctId}, #{reqTycd}, #{smstrChrtId}, #{orgId}, #{deptId}, #{userRprsId}, #{userReqUrl}, #{userTycd}, #{naviPosnm}, #{cntnIp}, #{cntnDvcTycd}, #{cntnBrwsr}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), #{sessId}, #{sessSdttm}, #{rgtrId}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), SYSDATE, #{dayOfWeek}, #{hourOfDay}, #{traceId} )

INSERT INTO DEV_LMS.TB_LMS_LOG_TUT_ACTV ( TUT_ACTV_ID, USER_ID, SESS_ID, SESS_SDTTM, SESS_EDTTM, TUT_ACTV_TYCD, TUT_ACTV_DTTM, TUT_REQ_MENU, TUT_REQ_URL, TUT_REQ_CTS, TUT_REQ_TYCD, TUT_CNTN_IP, TUT_CNTN_DVC_TYCD, TUT_CNTN_BRWSR, RGTR_ID, REG_DTTM, MDFR_ID, MOD_DTTM, SBJCT_ID, ACTV_DATETIME, DAYOFWEEK, HOUROFDAY, TRACE_ID ) VALUES ( #{tutActvId}, #{userId}, #{sessId}, #{sessSdttm}, #{sessEdttm}, #{tutActvTycd}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), -- 활동일시 #{tutReqMenu}, #{tutReqUrl}, #{tutReqCts}, #{tutReqTycd}, #{tutCntnIp}, #{tutCntnDvcTycd}, #{tutCntnBrwsr}, #{rgtrId}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), -- 등록일시 #{mdfrId}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), -- 수정일시 #{sbjctId}, SYSDATE, #{dayOfWeek}, #{hourOfDay} , #{traceId} )

AND ( U.STDNT_NO LIKE '%' || #{searchText} || '%' OR U.USERNM LIKE '%' || #{searchText} || '%' OR LUA.CNTN_IP LIKE '%' || #{searchText} || '%' )

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY LUA.REG_DTTM DESC) AS LINE_NO, O.ORGNM, D.DEPT_ID, U.STDNT_NO, U.USERNM, U.USER_ID, LUA.CNTN_IP, LUA.SESS_SDTTM, LUA.SESS_EDTTM, CASE WHEN LUA.SESS_SDTTM IS NOT NULL AND LUA.SESS_EDTTM IS NOT NULL THEN (LUA.SESS_EDTTM - LUA.SESS_SDTTM) * 24 * 60 END AS SESS_MIN FROM TB_LMS_LOG_USER_ACTV LUA INNER JOIN TB_LMS_USER U ON LUA.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND U.USER_TYCD = 'ADM' LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT S ON LUA.SBJCT_ID = S.SBJCT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_DEPT D ON U.DEPT_ID = U.DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_ORG O ON U.ORG_ID = O.ORG_ID WHERE 1 = 1
AND ( U.STDNT_NO LIKE '%' || #{searchText} || '%' OR U.USERNM LIKE '%' || #{searchText} || '%' OR LUA.CNTN_IP LIKE '%' || #{searchText} || '%' )
